description: Dylan is attacked by a mysterious pale creature, leaving suspicious wounds on his neck and descending into madness, muttering "Triumphant Return." The investigators flee in panic onto the last Orient Express. From the shadows of the platform, crimson eyes watch silently. Next stop: Venice

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (I think the Fascists are completely impossible to negotiate with

conversation.speaker: player5

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: At exactly 8 PM, the sound of the conductor's baton lightly tapping the stand cuts through the silence, and a thin, sharp high note reverberates throughout the hall. As the familiar melody begins, the investigators immediately recognize it as the very tune Caterina improvised on the Orient Express.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The audience remains immersed in the strange collective humming atmosphere, almost no one noticing the anomaly.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ow, that hurts"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: As the aria ends, the old man singing with Caterina's voice gasps for breath, appearing very weak. The stage backdrop changes to the scene of the Temple of Ptah. Priests holding incense circle the entering Radamès, and the smoke slowly drifts into the audience.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Struggle to calm down and sit back down.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: After the priests present the sword and battle boots to Radamès, a spotlight suddenly illuminates the center of the stage—Radamès's armor is worn on a giant tailor's mannequin. As the priests remove the armor, the spotlight reveals the milky-white, headless torso statue. The luster and texture of its material perfectly match the left arm statue the investigators are searching for.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Struggle.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Doctor, what do you think that old man's identity is?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player2 and Johnson see the stage assistants starting to push the statue backstage. The props manager Marco waves at them: Come give a hand! Help move this one back to the props room.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Go up and help

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Recall the wound on that big star's neck earlier

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player2 and Johnson carry the statue left and right, arriving at the empty corridor. The wheels creak on the wooden floor, echoing in the unmanned passage.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: (His direct cause of death was having his chest slit open

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Look at the Blackshirts at the exit

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player2 glances toward the exit leading outside and immediately freezes in place—two Blackshirts lie collapsed by the door, their skin gray-white and shriveled, like emptied-out skins. The old man who once sang with Caterina's voice lies face up, his twig-like fingers still clutching at the door, his eye sockets sunken into two black holes. Four burly men are piled like discarded dolls beside the fire hydrant, their suits hanging loosely on their shriveled bodies. The old woman curls up under the ticket-checking counter, the wound on her neck already blackened and hardened. In the shadows, a pair of pale hands flashes and disappears.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Did you get the thing?"

conversation.speaker: player2

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player4 struggles even more violently under Bailan's restraint, his eyeballs bulging almost out of their sockets. An inhuman gurgling sound comes from his throat, drool uncontrollably flowing down his chin. Triumphant Return... Triumphant Return...
